	"variants" []Variant omitempty
	"wireTagged" bool
	method (*Union) MarshalJSONTo(*encoding/json/jsontext.Encoder) error
	method (*Union) UnmarshalJSONFrom(*encoding/json/jsontext.Decoder) error

type Unmodeled map[string]UnmodeledEntry

type UnmodeledEntry struct
	"provenance" Provenance
	"reason" UnmodeledReason
	"value" encoding/json/jsontext.Value

type UnmodeledReason string
	const "degraded_lowering"
	const "no_ir_home"
	const "out_of_scope"
	const "validation_only"
	const "vendor_extension"

type Value struct
	"bool" bool omitzero
	"bytes" []uint8 omitempty
	"constructor" *ConstructorValue omitzero
	"kind" ValueKind
	"list" []Value omitempty
	"number" BigVal omitempty
	"object" []Field omitempty
	"ref" *ValueRef omitzero
	"string" string omitempty

type ValueKind string
	const "bool"
	const "bytes"
	const "constructor"
	const "infinity"
	const "list"
	const "nan"
	const "negative-infinity"
	const "null"
	const "number"
	const "object"
	const "reference"
	const "string"
	const "symbol"

type ValueRef struct
	"member" string omitempty
	"type" TypeID omitempty

type Variant struct
	"availability" *Availability omitzero
	"deprecation" *Deprecation omitzero
	"docs" Docs
	"event" *EventInfo omitzero
	"examples" []Example omitempty
	"name" Naming
	"type" TypeRef
	"unmodeled" Unmodeled omitempty
	"wireID" *int omitzero
	"wireName" string omitempty
	"xml" *XMLHints omitzero

type VersionedBool struct
	"version" string omitempty
	"wasRequired" bool

type VersionedName struct
	"name" string omitempty
	"version" string omitempty

type VersionedType struct
	"type" TypeRef
	"version" string omitempty

type Visibility struct
	"invisibleInEveryLifecycle" bool
	"only" []string omitempty

type WireIDRange struct
	"from" int
	"to" int

type XMLHints struct
	"attribute" *bool omitzero
	"name" string omitempty
	"namespace" string omitempty
	"nodeType" string omitempty
	"prefix" string omitempty
	"wrapped" *bool omitzero

type encoding/json/jsontext.Pointer string

type encoding/json/jsontext.Value []uint8
	method (*encoding/json/jsontext.Value) UnmarshalJSON([]byte) error
	method (encoding/json/jsontext.Value) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
